author: Stelian Vultur

mutation.description: raise the object-graph depth limit of MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData (the preset for untrusted input) from 500 to 5000; TrustedData and the property default stay 500
mutation.intended_effect: a hostile msgpack sequence nested 500-5000 deep is no longer rejected (InsufficientExecutionStackException) at depth 500; the type's own doc comment says ~2000 nested arrays can overflow a 1 MB stack, and a stack overflow kills the process: a denial-of-service downgrade in a security-sensitive file, outside anything the 2283 branch touches
